| Category = Hamburger recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] ground [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|chuck]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 tbsp freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|granulated garlic]]
*4 hamburger buns, split in half and toasted
*[[Cookbook:Rapeseed Oil|Canola]] or [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*4 slices pepper jack [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]

== Procedure ==
#Form meat into 4 equal patties, about ¾ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick. Make a depression in the center with your thumb and set aside.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] patties with oil. Sprinkle on both sides with seasonings.
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]. Add patties and cook, turning often, until desired "doneness" is achieved. Remove to a plate, top each with a slice of cheese, and cover tightly with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest until cheese is melted.
#Brush cut sides of bread with oil. Add a patty onto the bottom half of a bun, then top with the upper half. Repeat with remaining meat and serve immediately.

Brush patties with oil. Sprinkle on both sides with seasonings.

Preheat grill. Add patties and cook, turning often, until desired "doneness" is achieved. Remove to a plate, top each with a slice of cheese, and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Let rest until cheese is melted.
